# Teemous Digital Lab

> Teemous Digital Lab is a specialized digital identity & AI creative engineering lab founded by Ngô Quang Sinh in Da Nang, Vietnam. It engineers bespoke digital portfolio hubs, autonomous AI agent workflows, and turnkey cloud infrastructure for ambitious Gen Z builders, students, and young professionals.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Living Portfolio Hubs](https://teemousdigital.id.vn/portfolio/): High-performance, bespoke personal branding and portfolio websites replacing flat PDF resumes with verified credentials and proof of work.
- [Autonomous AI Agents](https://teemousdigital.id.vn/services/): Purpose-built conversational AI agents answering recruiter questions 24/7 and specialized workflow automation tools.
- [Turnkey Digital Infrastructure](https://teemousdigital.id.vn/services/): Scalable edge deployment on custom domains with Cloudflare security.
- [Social Media Growth Terminal](https://teemousdigital.id.vn/services/social/): Strategic engagement acceleration across Meta & TikTok ecosystems.

## Flagship Portfolio Showcase
- [Trần Thị Thùy Dương](https://teemousdigital.id.vn/portfolio/tranthithuyduong/): Software Engineering & Algorithms (VKU, Top 6 SheCodes, ICPC National).
- [Lê Thái Trung](https://teemousdigital.id.vn/portfolio/lethaitrung/): Backend Development & Distributed Architecture.
- [Ngô Quang Sinh](https://teemousdigital.id.vn/portfolio/ngoquangsinh/): Founder, AI Automation & Digital Systems (Duy Tân University).
- [Bùi Lưu Bảo Hân](https://teemousdigital.id.vn/portfolio/builuubaohan/): HR Operations & Community Building.
